warning: All event rates, delays, costs, and mitigations are illustrative stress assumptions for control design. They are not measured ReHarvest probabilities, Egyptian market forecasts, legal limits, or insurance estimates.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the primary truck arrives with less fuel than the planned route and reserve require.
risks.consequence: The truck can stop before pickup or delivery, causing delay, heat exposure, diversion cost, and possible rejection.
risks.prevention: Calculate route distance plus detours and require enough usable fuel for the route with at least a 25% reserve. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Compare a current dashboard photo, odometer, fuel receipt, route distance, and declared vehicle consumption.
risks.fallback: Send a fuel-approved backup truck or a mobile fuel response before cargo is loaded; never improvise after the load is stranded.
risks.appControl: A fuel-range gate blocks route release unless the primary and two backup trucks each have fresh fuel evidence and sufficient range.
risks.requiredEvidence: Timestamped fuel gauge and odometer photos, last receipt, planned kilometres, reserve calculation, backup confirmations.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, service brakes fade, pull, leak, or do not stop the loaded vehicle normally.
risks.consequence: Loss of braking, steering, lighting, or visibility can injure people and destroy cargo and equipment.
risks.prevention: Require safety-system inspection and prohibit route release when a brake, steering, light, mirror, horn, or wiper defect exists. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Use a signed pre-trip test with photos or video and compare open defects from the prior route.
risks.fallback: Keep the vehicle parked, replace it, and escalate the defect to qualified maintenance; never waive a safety-critical item.
risks.appControl: Safety-critical defects are non-overridable dispatch blocks and remain attached to the vehicle until verified closed.
risks.requiredEvidence: Brake and parking-brake test, steering play, lights, indicators, reflectors, mirrors, horn, wipers, defect closure.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, chemical, fuel, fertilizer, pesticide, or detergent residue remains in the cargo bay.
risks.consequence: The produce can be contaminated, tainted, rejected, or implicated in a food-safety complaint.
risks.prevention: Declare previous cargo, clean and dry the load area, isolate chemicals, inspect pests and odours, and approve the bay before loading. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Use current interior photographs, previous-cargo declaration, cleaning record, odour/pest check, and inspector sign-off.
risks.fallback: Reject the vehicle, reclean and reinspect, or use a clean backup; quarantine anything already exposed.
risks.appControl: The cargo-bay hygiene gate cannot pass without traceable cleaning evidence and a compatible previous-cargo declaration.
risks.requiredEvidence: Interior photos, cleaning time and method, previous cargo, pest/odour result, inspector identity.

risks.prevention: Declare previous cargo, clean and dry the load area, isolate chemicals, inspect pests and odours, and approve the bay before loading. Invalidate the previous release and require the affected checks and evidence to be approved again.
risks.detection: Use current interior photographs, previous-cargo declaration, cleaning record, odour/pest check, and inspector sign-off.
risks.fallback: Reject the vehicle, reclean and reinspect, or use a clean backup; quarantine anything already exposed.
risks.appControl: The cargo-bay hygiene gate cannot pass without traceable cleaning evidence and a compatible previous-cargo declaration.
risks.requiredEvidence: Interior photos, cleaning time and method, previous cargo, pest/odour result, inspector identity.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the assigned payload is below the purchased produce and packaging weight.
risks.consequence: Overload, poor balance, or moving cargo can damage produce, destabilize the truck, or breach road restrictions.
risks.prevention: Calculate usable payload, crate count, volume, axle distribution, stack pattern, and securement before assigning the vehicle. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Compare planned and actual loaded weight, dimensions, crate count, axle position, strap plan, and door closure.
risks.fallback: Split the load across verified vehicles, reduce quantity with buyer approval, or replace the vehicle before departure.
risks.appControl: The load planner rejects vehicles below capacity and blocks release when actual weight, crate count, or securement differs from plan.
risks.requiredEvidence: Vehicle payload, dimensions, scale slip, crate manifest, loading diagram, straps, doors, seals, departure photos.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, no backup truck was registered for the route.
risks.consequence: A single failed truck, driver, depot, or contractor can cancel the entire delivery with no recoverable option.
risks.prevention: Register a primary and at least two independently verified backup truck-driver pairs with capacity, fuel, hygiene, and response times. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Reconfirm every backup for the exact window and detect shared depot, driver, fuel, ownership, or geographic dependencies.
risks.fallback: Escalate in order of verified response time and capacity, then split the load or reschedule under buyer-approved rules.
risks.appControl: The fleet redundancy gate requires three viable truck-driver pairs and blocks backups that share the same hidden point of failure.
risks.requiredEvidence: Vehicle and driver records, capacity, location, response time, current availability, independence check, acceptance timestamp.

risks.prevention: Verify map pin, written directions, gate name, access rules, loading window, onsite contact, and waiting area before departure. Recalculate capacity, stop sequence, reserve time, and recovery options whenever one stop changes.
risks.detection: Require supplier reconfirmation and driver acknowledgement; alert when the truck is not progressing to the verified pin.
risks.fallback: Use a second contact or meeting point, hold at a safe location, or cancel before deterioration and extra waiting cost escalate.
risks.appControl: Pickup details expire and must be reconfirmed; a missing gate contact or changed pin invalidates route release.
risks.requiredEvidence: Verified pin, landmark directions, gate/contact, access instructions, loading slot, reconfirmation time.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the produce is not harvested or collected when the vehicle arrives.
risks.consequence: A truck may arrive for unavailable, incomplete, incorrect, or repriced produce, wasting transport and breaking buyer commitments.
risks.prevention: Require a time-bounded supplier confirmation of lot, grade, quantity, price, readiness, labour, documents, and backup lot. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Use a live readiness checklist with current photos and estimated finished weight before dispatching the vehicle.
risks.fallback: Activate a verified backup lot, split sourcing, reduce the order with buyer approval, or cancel before transport cost is committed.
risks.appControl: Supplier readiness expires before dispatch and material changes automatically reopen economics and buyer approval.
risks.requiredEvidence: Lot ID, current photos, ready quantity, price, grade, labour, documents, backup lot, confirmation timestamp.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, produce retains field heat or is loaded after prolonged sun exposure.
risks.consequence: Heat, moisture, maturity, decay, pressure, or incompatible packing can turn usable produce into rejection or a safety problem.
risks.prevention: Define measurable grade and condition limits, shade and ventilation rules, packaging, loading temperature, and maximum elapsed time. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Use representative inspection samples, temperature where relevant, photos, defect percentages, moisture, odour, and time stamps.
risks.fallback: Reject or re-sort before loading, divert to an approved use, reduce the accepted quantity, or quarantine unsafe produce.
risks.appControl: Condition evidence is lot-specific and expires; unsafe findings are non-overridable while cosmetic deviations require buyer approval.
risks.requiredEvidence: Lot sample, defect %, maturity, odour, moisture, temperature where relevant, packaging, time out of shade.

risks.prevention: Define measurable grade and condition limits, shade and ventilation rules, packaging, loading temperature, and maximum elapsed time. Shorten the evidence-expiry window and require heat, shade, water, and route-buffer checks.
risks.detection: Use representative inspection samples, temperature where relevant, photos, defect percentages, moisture, odour, and time stamps.
risks.fallback: Reject or re-sort before loading, divert to an approved use, reduce the accepted quantity, or quarantine unsafe produce.
risks.appControl: Condition evidence is lot-specific and expires; unsafe findings are non-overridable while cosmetic deviations require buyer approval.
risks.requiredEvidence: Lot sample, defect %, maturity, odour, moisture, temperature where relevant, packaging, time out of shade.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the destination name is correct but the address or branch is wrong.

risks.prevention: Validate destination, truck restrictions, stop order, primary route, two alternatives, safe waiting points, and driver understanding. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Use route acknowledgement and exception alerts when the vehicle is late, stationary, or materially off plan where lawful.
risks.fallback: Switch to a preapproved route, contact the receiver, adjust stop sequence, or divert before the remaining shelf-life is exhausted.
risks.appControl: Every released route packet includes offline directions, plan A/B/C, restriction notes, stop windows, and escalation contacts.
risks.requiredEvidence: Verified addresses and pins, route alternatives, restrictions, stop order, safe stops, driver acknowledgement.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the driver's phone battery dies during the route.
risks.consequence: A preventable issue becomes a major loss when the driver, supplier, buyer, or operator cannot communicate quickly.
risks.prevention: Require charged primary and backup phones, power banks, airtime/data, offline packet, current contacts, and timed acknowledgements. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Run a communication check before departure and escalate missed heartbeats or critical acknowledgements.
risks.fallback: Use voice/SMS/alternate network, backup contact, offline instructions, and fixed escalation times; never rely on one chat thread.
risks.appControl: The communication gate checks device power, contact validity, offline access, and backup channel before route release.
risks.requiredEvidence: Battery level, charger/power bank, SIM/network, primary and backup contacts, acknowledgement and escalation log.

risks.prevention: Require charged primary and backup phones, power banks, airtime/data, offline packet, current contacts, and timed acknowledgements. Recalculate capacity, stop sequence, reserve time, and recovery options whenever one stop changes.
risks.detection: Run a communication check before departure and escalate missed heartbeats or critical acknowledgements.
risks.fallback: Use voice/SMS/alternate network, backup contact, offline instructions, and fixed escalation times; never rely on one chat thread.
risks.appControl: The communication gate checks device power, contact validity, offline access, and backup channel before route release.
risks.requiredEvidence: Battery level, charger/power bank, SIM/network, primary and backup contacts, acknowledgement and escalation log.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the named receiver is absent, late, sick, or no longer employed.
risks.consequence: The truck can arrive to no receiver, no dock, no scale, changed terms, or rejection while the produce deteriorates.
risks.prevention: Reconfirm receiver, window, gate, unloading labour, scale, accepted quantity, price, tolerance, payment, and backup receiver. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Require a timed buyer acknowledgement before dispatch and again before the final leg; alert on any changed field.
risks.fallback: Use an authorized backup receiver, safe waiting limit, partial acceptance, diversion buyer, or cancellation terms.
risks.appControl: Buyer readiness expiry blocks the final leg and any change to quantity, price, or criteria reopens approval and economics.
risks.requiredEvidence: Receiver and backup, window, gate/dock, labour, scale, criteria, payment status, reconfirmation timestamp.

risks.prevention: Risk-assess routes and stops, minimize cash, protect contacts and cargo details, use safe waiting points, seals, and check-ins. Invalidate the previous release and require the affected checks and evidence to be approved again.
risks.detection: Use missed-check-in, route exception, seal, incident, duress, and emergency escalation procedures where lawful.
risks.fallback: Prioritize human safety, contact emergency services, stop distribution, preserve evidence, notify insurers/advisers, and quarantine cargo.
risks.appControl: A security incident immediately locks route actions, settlement, and downstream distribution and opens a controlled response checklist.
risks.requiredEvidence: Route risk assessment, check-ins, seal numbers, incident time/location, involved people, authorities, quarantine decision.

risks.scenario: During a pre-dawn pickup with reduced staffing and low visibility, the lot identifier is missing, duplicated, changed, detached, or unreadable.
risks.consequence: A contaminated or untraceable load can harm people, trigger recall, destroy trust, and create severe legal and financial exposure.
risks.prevention: Keep lot identity, source, handling, treatment, inspection, vehicle, recipients, quantities, and incident procedures linked end to end. Require an evening reconfirmation plus a wake-up and gate-access check 60 minutes before departure.
risks.detection: Validate traceability completeness, hygiene and condition evidence, complaint signals, mixed lots, and safety exceptions.
risks.fallback: Stop distribution, quarantine all linked quantities, identify recipients, preserve samples/evidence, and escalate under the approved plan.
risks.appControl: Safety events are non-overridable locks with one-step backward and forward traceability, quarantine, recipient list, and recall workflow.
risks.requiredEvidence: Supplier and lot, harvest/source, treatment where applicable, inspection, vehicle, weights, buyers, accepted/rejected/diverted quantities.
